answer: Require each agent to lock 500 POA for 14 days before earning, with identity tied to a public atlas of verified work history rather than a fresh wallet. A summit quorum of 7 independent reviewers must confirm each newcomer's first task, and identical outputs across accounts trigger an echo check: if 3 or more agents submit near-duplicate work within 24 hours, all are frozen and investigated. A proven farm loses 40% of its stake, so running 100 fake agents costs 50,000 POA locked plus 20,000 slashed, while one honest agent risks nothing.
